<!-- 10.Accumulation_report.Rmd — Per-gene CAAS accumulation results by direction. -->
<!-- PhyloPhere | subworkflows/CT_ACCUMULATION/local/ -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "100%")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(DT)
  library(paletteer)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

.tableau10 <- as.character(paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_10"))
dir_colours <- c(top = .tableau10[1], bottom = .tableau10[2], all = .tableau10[3])

theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y  = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 20, r = 20)),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 5)),
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", hjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 10))
  )
)
fdr_thr   <- params$fdr_threshold
pval_thr  <- fdr_thr
accum_dir <- params$accum_dir
```

```{r load-data}
# ── Load the results CSV of each direction ────────────────────────────────────
directions <- c("top", "bottom", "all")

load_direction_csv <- function(direction) {
  path <- file.path(accum_dir, sprintf("accumulation_%s_results.csv", direction))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(direction = direction)
}

raw <- map_dfr(directions, load_direction_csv)

has_data <- nrow(raw) > 0
if (!has_data) stop("No accumulation CSVs found under: ", accum_dir)

# Standardize the gene column name (Gene / gene)
if ("Gene" %in% names(raw) && !"gene" %in% names(raw)) raw <- rename(raw, gene = Gene)

# ── BH FDR per direction, excluding genes with ActualCount = 0 ────────────────
# Genes with ActualCount = 0 have p = 1 by construction, not by test, and must not
# enter the FDR denominator: they would inflate it and reduce power.
accum <- raw %>%
  mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = directions)) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = {
      tested <- !is.na(ActualCount) & ActualCount > 0 & !is.na(PValue)
      q      <- rep(NA_real_, n())
      if (any(tested))
        q[tested] <- p.adjust(PValue[tested], method = "BH")
      q
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(significant = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < pval_thr)
```

---

```{r test-description, results='asis'}
cat(
  "> **Test.** For each direction, a gene is tested with an exact hypergeometric test: the K observed ",
  "CAAS positions of the direction are taken as a uniform draw without replacement from the universe U ",
  "(the positions CAAStools tested that score in at least one cycle of the filtered permulation null, ",
  "plus the observed positions), and the p-value is the probability that the gene holds at least its ",
  "observed number of CAAS positions. `PoolPositions` is the number of positions of the gene in U, ",
  "through which its length enters; `MeanNull` and `SD` are the mean and standard deviation of the null ",
  "count. A position detected on both sides counts once in `all`. Positions are treated as independent ",
  "draws, which understates the variance of genes with many positions in U, so the results are a ",
  "ranking rather than a list of significant genes.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Overview

```{r overview-table}
summary_tbl <- accum %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes        = n_distinct(gene),
    n_tested       = sum(!is.na(ActualCount) & ActualCount > 0),
    n_significant  = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_significant = round(100 * sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE) / max(n_tested, 1), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(direction)

DT::datatable(
  summary_tbl,
  caption  = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
    sprintf("Significant genes (FDR < %g) per direction | Trait: %s",
            fdr_thr, params$traitname)
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  options  = list(pageLength = 21, dom = "t")
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle("n_significant",
    background = DT::styleColorBar(range(summary_tbl$n_significant), "#cce5ff"),
    backgroundSize = "98% 88%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
    backgroundPosition = "center"
  )
```

---

## Observed vs expected count {.tabset}

```{r scatter-tabs, results='asis'}
for (dir in directions) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", str_to_title(dir)))
  sub <- accum %>% filter(direction == dir)
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) { cat("*No data.*\n\n"); next }

  p <- ggplot(sub, aes(x = MeanNull, y = ActualCount, colour = significant)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = sub %>% filter(significant) %>% arrange(PValue) %>% slice_head(n = 20),
      aes(label = gene), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = dir_colours[[dir]])) +
    labs(
      x      = "Expected count under the null",
      y      = "Actual count",
      colour = sprintf("FDR < %g", fdr_thr),
      title  = sprintf("Direction: %s | Trait: %s", str_to_title(dir), params$traitname)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

---

## P-value distributions {.tabset}

```{r pval-tabs, results='asis'}
for (dir in directions) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", str_to_title(dir)))
  sub <- accum %>% filter(direction == dir, !is.na(PValue), !is.na(ActualCount), ActualCount > 0)
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) { cat("*No data.*\n\n"); next }

  p <- ggplot(sub, aes(x = PValue)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, alpha = 0.7, colour = "white", fill = .tableau10[1]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = fdr_thr, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
    labs(x = "Exact hypergeometric p-value", y = "Gene count",
         title = sprintf("Direction: %s", str_to_title(dir))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Significant genes {.tabset}

> Genes with at least one observed CAAS (ActualCount > 0) are tested; significance is evaluated by exact hypergeometric p-value, adjusted by Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (`FDR <` the threshold set by `fdr_threshold`).

```{r sig-tables, results='asis'}
for (dir in directions) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", str_to_title(dir)))
  sig <- accum %>%
    filter(direction == dir, significant) %>%
    select(gene, ActualCount, PoolPositions, MeanNull, SD, PValue, FDR) %>%
    arrange(FDR, gene) %>%
    mutate(PValue = formatC(PValue, format = "e", digits = 2))

  if (nrow(sig) == 0) { cat("*No significant genes.*\n\n"); next }

  print(
    knitr::kable(
      sig, rownames = FALSE, digits = 4, format = "html", escape = TRUE,
      caption = sprintf("Significant genes | direction: %s | FDR < %g", str_to_title(dir), fdr_thr)
    ) %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  )
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

---

```{r write-summary}
# Summary TSV: one row per significant (gene, direction)
sig_summary <- accum %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  group_by(gene, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    min_pval = min(PValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_fdr  = min(FDR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(direction, min_fdr)

out_tsv <- file.path(params$output_dir, paste0("accumulation_summary_", params$traitname, ".tsv"))
write_tsv(sig_summary, out_tsv)

invisible(NULL)
```
